basic_details.job_title: NIT Agartala Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 5 Project Associate, Field Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Agartala, Tripura, has invited applications for five temporary posts in the ANRF-funded project "AI-Assisted Digital Curation and Global Promotion of North-East Indian Folklore: A Focus on Manipur and Tripura": one Junior Research Fellow (JRF), two Project Associates (Language and Computer Science, one each) and two Field Assistants. Pay is ₹37,000 + HRA for the JRF and Project Associates and ₹27,000 + HRA per month for Field Assistants. The upper age limit is 30 years. Applications must be emailed to [email protected] on or before 28 November 2026 (11:59 PM IS

age_limit.details: The upper age limit for JRF, Project Associate and Field Assistant candidates is 30 years, with age relaxation for OBC/SC/ST/Women/PwD candidates as per GoI norms. The application form asks for age as on 28.11.2026. The notice does not print the relaxation in years. | Candidates should confirm they are eligible for the post they apply for before appearing for the interview. Discipline-specific eligibility for each post is in the official notification.

rows.details: "AI-Assisted Digital Curation and Global Promotion of North-East Indian Folklore: A Focus on Manipur and Tripura" (ANRF/SSH/2025/000433/DH)
Project duration five years (23 October 2026 to 22 October 2031); JRF and Project Associates 5 years, Field Assistants 3 years
Junior Research Fellow (JRF); Project Associate - I (Language); Project Associate – I (Computer Science); Field Assistant
₹37,000 + HRA (JRF, Project Associates); ₹27,000 + HRA per month (Field Assistant)
Upper age limit 30 years, with relaxation for OBC/SC/ST/Women/PwD candidates as per GoI norms

content_sections.heading: About NIT Agartala
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technology Agartala is located at Barjala, Jirania, West Tripura, PIN 799046 (telephone +91 381 2346630/6629, fax +91 381 2346360). The project is led by Principal Investigator Dr. Gyanabati Khuraijam, Associate Professor, Department of MHSS, NIT Agartala. The Co-PIs named in the notice are Prof. Debasis Neogi (MHSS, NIT Agartala), Dr. Kunal Chakma and Dr. Anupam Jamatia (CSE, NIT Agartala), Dr. Yumnam Oken Singh (Dept. of Basic Science & Humanities, CAU, Imphal) and Dr. Thounaojam Ruhichand Singh (Dept. of Umang Lai Haraoba, Manipur University of Culture, Imphal).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Experience is not specified in the notice for any post. Knowledge and/or hands-on experience in Python programming, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Large Language Models (LLMs), Information Retrieval, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). OCR and speech-to-text technologies; data processing, database management, and metadata structuring. Digital libraries and archiving platforms; GPU-enabled computing, cloud platforms, and High-Performance Computing (HPC). Familiarity with Linux, Git/GitHub, and multilingual language processing will be an added advantage. Preference shall be given to the native speakers of the Meiteilon and/or Kokborok languages. The upper age limit for JRF, Project Associate and Field Assistant candidates is 30 years, with age relaxation for OBC/SC/ST/Women/PwD candidates as per GoI norms. The application form asks for age as on 28.11.2026. The notice does not print the relaxation in years. Candidates should confirm they are eligible for the post they apply for before appearing for the interview. Discipline-specific eligibility for each post is in the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: MA in English / Cultural Studies / Folklore with NET/JRF. Essential: familiarity with Manipuri/ Kokborok culture and language.
MA in Linguistics / Applied Linguistics / Computational Linguistics with NET/JRF. Essential: familiarity with Manipuri and/or Kokborok language, and skills in translation and transcription.
M.Tech or MSc in Computer Science, Computer Science and Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or Data Science, with a valid GATE score.

MA in Anthropology / Tribal Studies / Cultural Studies / Folklore / Sociology / History. Essential: knowledge of local languages and communities of Manipur (Manipuri) / Tripura (Kokborok), along with photography and videography skills.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow: 5 years, coterminous with the project, upgradable to SRF after 2 years as per ANRF norms; HRA as per institute/ANRF rules. Project Associates (Language and Computer Science): 5 years, coterminous with the project. Field Assistants: 3 years. JRF and Project Associates will be provided with an opportunity to register for PhD at NIT Agartala.

content_sections.text: The notice asks for applications by email only. It prints no online portal and no postal address for applications. Fill in the application form printed in the notice. Tick the post applied for. The form lists the two Project Associate posts as Research Associate (Language) and Research Associate (Computer Science). Give GATE score details if applying for the Computer Science post, and NET/JRF details if applying for JRF or the Language post. Field Assistant applicants indicate their preferred language/community, if applicable. Attach a photograph, signed copies of educational qualifications, research publications and a statement of interest (preferably not exceeding one page). Email the application to Dr. Gyanabati Khuraijam, Associate Professor, Department of MHSS, National Institute of Technology Agartala, Tripura, at [email protected] on or before 28 November 2026 (11:59 PM IST). Filled application form with a recent passport-size photograph Signed copy of educational qualifications; self-attested copies of certificates/mark sheets, as the form states Research publications Statement of interest Experience certificates, where available

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted applicants will be notified of the date, time and venue of the interview after 01 December 2026. The interview will be held in hybrid mode, with both online and offline participation. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed, through the email given in the application form. On selection, an engagement letter will be sent by email. The notice states that no TA/DA is permissible for appearing in the interview and joining in case of selection. Selected candidates must bring original documents and experience certificate(s) at joining for verification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIT Agartala Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 1 Junior Research Fellow, 2 Project Associates (1 Language, 1 Computer Science) and 2 Field Assistants (1 Manipuri, 1 Kokborok).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent on or before 28 November 2026 (11:59 PM IST).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The JRF post requires an MA in English / Cultural Studies / Folklore with NET/JRF. Familiarity with Manipuri/ Kokborok culture and language is essential.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Associate – I (Computer Science)?
faq.answer: The post requires an M.Tech or MSc in Computer Science, Computer Science and Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or Data Science, with a valid GATE score.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for JRF, Project Associate and Field Assistant candidates is 30 years, with relaxation for OBC/SC/ST/Women/PwD candidates as per GoI norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: JRF and Project Associates get ₹37,000 + HRA; Field Assistants get ₹27,000 + HRA per month for 3 years. The JRF's HRA is as per institute/ANRF rules.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the filled application form with a photograph, signed copies of educational qualifications, research publications and a statement of interest to [email protected] by 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted applicants are called for an interview in hybrid mode (online and offline). They will be notified of the date, time and venue after 01 December 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No. The positions are purely temporary and tied to the ANRF project: 5 years for JRF and Project Associates, 3 years for Field Assistants. The engagement can be terminated without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is permissible for appearing in the interview and joining in case of selection.
